name: Blood
look: Blood shield from dark cultivation fantasy. A thin dark crimson film shaped like a tall dome surrounds the character, veins of bright red flowing through it.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the whole crimson dome alone, its film and veins, no glow and no droplets
forms: bulging inward at the right where a blow lands
sagging and melting down, half drained

parts.name: VEIN
parts.text: one stretch of bright red vein alone, branching
forms: a thin stream of blood rising from the ground
a thick stream rising and curling over
a stream dripping down into the ground

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: blood droplets, a splash, red mist puffs

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the dome, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: blood rises from the ground in streams and spreads into the dome
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the film holds, red veins flowing slowly across it and droplets sliding down; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the film bulges inward at the impact point and droplets splatter out to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the film loses its shape and drains down into the ground as dripping streams
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
